desc.en: When equipped by an [Assassin] character, grants the following effect. / Grants Assault when the equipping character lands a Support Skill, increasing Lightning DMG by 10% and Crit Rate by 6%. Switching to the equipping character removes Assault after 1s. / Fusion Level 5: Gains 0.06% ATK Boost for every 10 points of Assassin proficiency. (Max: 5%)
